295 likes, 42 comments - trishalalovebug on August 19, 2026: "A little slice of luxury in the Blue City ✨
Param Vilas is a 250 year old heritage haveli in the heart of Jodhpur, beautifully restored with traditional Rajasthani architecture, handcrafted details and all the little comforts that make you want to slow down. From its private courtyard and plunge pool to the quiet corners that make you forget you’re in the middle of the Blue City 💙".
